title: MoS2 Contact Resistance Quantitative Design Rules and Strategic Engineering Matrix

technology_recommendations.application: Sub-1nm CMOS Node Ultra-High-Performance Logic (IRDS Target)
technology_recommendations.recommended_contact_strategy: Van der Waals transferred semimetal: Bismuth Bi(0001) or Antimony Sb(0001)
technology_recommendations.interface_engineering: Pristine physical transfer in inert glovebox (< 0.1 ppm O2/H2O) to prevent surface oxidation.
technology_recommendations.gate_dielectric_spec: Dual-gated geometry with high-k HfO2 or ZrO2 (EOT < 0.8 nm), providing n_2D >= 1.8e13 cm^-2.
technology_recommendations.thermal_budget_limit: Maintain T_processing < 240 deg C to prevent bismuth balling/dewetting.

technology_recommendations.application: Standard Foundry CMOS Fab-Line Compatible Integration
technology_recommendations.recommended_contact_strategy: Low-work-function reactive transition metal: Titanium (Ti) or Scandium (Sc) with Au/Pt cap
technology_recommendations.interface_engineering: Ultra-high vacuum e-beam evaporation (< 10^-8 Torr) with slow initial deposition rate (0.1 A/s) to minimize kinetic impact damage.
technology_recommendations.gate_dielectric_spec: Back-gated SiO2 (30-50 nm) or Al2O3 top-gate, operating at n_2D >= 1.0e13 cm^-2.
technology_recommendations.thermal_budget_limit: Post-metal vacuum annealing at 250 - 300 deg C in Ar/H2 forming gas to induce mild interfacial sulfur reaction and reduce pinning.

technology_recommendations.application: Cryogenic 2D Superconducting / Quantum Readout Electronics (4 K - 77 K)
technology_recommendations.recommended_contact_strategy: Chemically converted 1T metallic phase MoS2 homojunction or Nb/MoS2 superconducting contact
technology_recommendations.interface_engineering: Local n-butyl lithium or laser-assisted phase transformation to eliminate Schottky barrier freeze-out entirely (Phi_B ~ 0 eV).
technology_recommendations.gate_dielectric_spec: h-BN encapsulated gate stack to suppress cryogenic charged impurity scattering.
technology_recommendations.thermal_budget_limit: Metastable 1T phase requires T < 100 deg C after chemical conversion to prevent relaxation back to 2H phase.

technology_recommendations.recommended_contact_strategy: Transferred monolayer graphene or low-temperature silver Ag nanowires
technology_recommendations.interface_engineering: Dry stamping van der Waals lamination at room temperature.
technology_recommendations.gate_dielectric_spec: High-capacitance ion gel or ALD Al2O3 deposited at 120 deg C.
technology_recommendations.thermal_budget_limit: Strict limit T < 150 deg C to preserve organic substrate dimensional stability.

key_design_takeaway: To break the 100 Ohm*um barrier, experimentalists must operate in Regime I: Gate carrier density must exceed 1.7e13 cm^-2 (requiring high-k dielectrics), and Schottky barrier height must be suppressed below 0.15 eV using van der Waals semimetals (Bi, Sb) or 1T-phase homojunctions.
